in_sanskrit.name: Susil
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Graceful, kind, and gentle
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Susil एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। The name Susil is derived from the Sanskrit word 'su' meaning 'good' and 'sila' meaning 'purity'. This name signifies a graceful, kind, and gentle soul. It is often used for babies born in spring, representing the renewal of life and the growth of new beginnings.
